Lab 9 (SQL part) — the database side of the capstone

PostgreSQL course · capstone after Chapter 16 · Suggested time: 90 minutes · 10 marks (3 + 3 + 2 + 2)

1. Overview

The SQL that Lab 9's application stands on, graded in the browser: C1 the two accounts, C4 the expand half of a zero-downtime rename, C7a the revenue report and C7b the index for "My orders". The Node.js + Prisma parts (adopting the database, endpoints, the checkout race, the pool under load, tests, the checklist and the restore drill) are the second exercise of this module, run on your machine. Schema public stands for the lab's schema shop.

General requirements

  • Exact names: ctshop_owner, ctshop_app, delivery_note, orders_sync_note, orders_customer_id_created_at_id_idx.
  • Every question is graded on a fresh CT Shop inside a transaction that is rolled back (roles included).

2. Submission files

├── Q1.sql    -- C1 · two accounts: the owner and the app (3 marks)
├── Q2.sql    -- C4 · expand: delivery_note next to note, kept in sync both ways (3 marks)
├── Q3.sql    -- C7a · the revenue report, months in Vietnam time (2 marks)
├── Q4.sql    -- C7b · an index that removes the Sort of "My orders" (2 marks)

3. Data model

4. Functional requirements

1. C1 · two accounts: the owner and the app 3 marks

Create ctshop_owner (LOGIN) and make it the owner of schema public and of every table in it. Create ctshop_app (LOGIN) with USAGE on the schema and SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE on every table — nothing more. Tables that ctshop_owner creates later must get the same four privileges for the app automatically. Timeouts on the roles: app statement_timeout 5s, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 10s, lock_timeout 3s; owner lock_timeout 5s, statement_timeout 0.

Requirements:

  • A DO block with format('ALTER TABLE public.%I OWNER TO ctshop_owner', tablename) over pg_tables.

2. C4 · expand: delivery_note next to note, kept in sync both ways 3 marks

App v1 reads/writes orders.note; v2 uses delivery_note; during the rolling deploy both run. Write the EXPAND migration: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s', add delivery_note text, a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger orders_sync_note that copies a write of either column into the other (on INSERT fill whichever is NULL), and back-fill the existing notes. (The CONTRACT — dropping note — is a later deploy.)

Requirements:

  • Compare OLD and NEW with IS DISTINCT FROM to know which version wrote.

3. C7a · the revenue report, months in Vietnam time 2 marks

For payments with paid_at in [1 Aug 2026, 1 Nov 2026) (Vietnam time) return thang ('YYYY-MM'), so_don (int), doanh_thu, luy_ke (running total) and tang_pct (growth vs the previous month, %, 1 decimal; NULL for the first), ordered by month. Prisma connects in UTC: the months must be Vietnamese months whatever the session time zone is.

Requirements:

  • date_trunc('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'); bounds as timestamptz '2026-08-01 00:00+07'.

4. C7b · an index that removes the Sort of "My orders" 2 marks

"My orders" runs SELECT id, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 3 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 2. Create orders_customer_id_created_at_id_idx so that the plan is an index scan that returns rows already in order — no Sort node, and LIMIT stops early. (On the server it is CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, alone in its own migration; the grader runs inside a transaction, so write the plain form here.)

Requirements:

  • Equality column first, then the ORDER BY columns with the same directions.

5. Grading rubric

Total10

Common deductions

  • The app logging in as the owner (or postgres).
  • Renaming a column in one step while v1 still runs.

6. Submission

Tabs Q1.sql … Q4.sql (C1, C4 expand, C7a, C7b). Run = sample checks; Submit = every check and the 10-mark table. Then do the application part (second exercise) on your machine.

Lab 9 (phần SQL) — phía CSDL của đồ án cuối khoá

Khoá PostgreSQL · đồ án sau Chương 16 · Thời gian gợi ý: 90 phút · 10 điểm (3 + 3 + 2 + 2)

1. Tổng quan

Phần SQL mà ứng dụng của Lab 9 đứng trên, chấm trong trình duyệt: C1 hai tài khoản, C4 nửa "mở rộng" của một lần đổi tên không gián đoạn, C7a báo cáo doanh thu và C7b chỉ mục cho "Đơn của tôi". Phần Node.js + Prisma (nhận CSDL có sẵn, endpoint, cuộc đua thanh toán, pool khi tải nặng, kiểm thử, checklist và diễn tập khôi phục) là đề thứ hai của module, chạy trên máy bạn. Schema public thay cho schema shop của lab.

Yêu cầu chung

  • Đúng tên: ctshop_owner, ctshop_app, delivery_note, orders_sync_note, orders_customer_id_created_at_id_idx.
  • Mỗi câu chấm trên một CT Shop sạch trong một giao dịch rồi bị huỷ (kể cả role).

2. Tệp nộp bài

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. C1 · hai tài khoản: chủ sở hữu và ứng dụng 3 điểm

Tạo ctshop_owner (LOGIN) và cho nó làm chủ schema public cùng mọi bảng trong đó. Tạo ctshop_app (LOGIN) có USAGE trên schema và SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE trên mọi bảng — không hơn. Bảng ctshop_owner tạo về sau phải tự có bốn quyền đó cho app. Timeout trên role: app statement_timeout 5s, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 10s, lock_timeout 3s; owner lock_timeout 5s, statement_timeout 0.

Yêu cầu:

  • Một khối DO với format('ALTER TABLE public.%I OWNER TO ctshop_owner', tablename) chạy qua pg_tables.

2. C4 · mở rộng: delivery_note cạnh note, đồng bộ hai chiều 3 điểm

App v1 đọc/ghi orders.note; v2 dùng delivery_note; trong lúc deploy cuốn chiếu cả hai cùng chạy. Viết migration MỞ RỘNG: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s', thêm delivery_note text, trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE orders_sync_note chép lần ghi vào một cột sang cột kia (khi INSERT thì điền cột đang NULL), và điền các ghi chú sẵn có. (CONTRACT — xoá note — là một lần deploy sau.)

Yêu cầu:

  • So OLD và NEW bằng IS DISTINCT FROM để biết phiên bản nào đã ghi.

3. C7a · báo cáo doanh thu, tháng theo giờ Việt Nam 2 điểm

Với các thanh toán có paid_at trong [1/8/2026, 1/11/2026) (giờ Việt Nam) trả về thang ('YYYY-MM'), so_don (int), doanh_thu, luy_ke (cộng dồn) và tang_pct (tăng so với tháng trước, %, 1 chữ số; NULL cho tháng đầu), sắp theo tháng. Prisma kết nối ở UTC: tháng phải là tháng Việt Nam bất kể múi giờ của phiên.

Yêu cầu:

  • date_trunc('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'); cận viết timestamptz '2026-08-01 00:00+07'.

4. C7b · chỉ mục bỏ được Sort của "Đơn của tôi" 2 điểm

"Đơn của tôi" chạy SELECT id, status, created_at FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 3 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 2. Tạo orders_customer_id_created_at_id_idx sao cho kế hoạch là một lượt quét chỉ mục trả dòng đã đúng thứ tự — không có nút Sort, và LIMIT dừng sớm. (Trên máy chủ là CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, đứng riêng trong migration của nó; máy chấm chạy trong giao dịch nên ở đây viết dạng thường.)

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột so bằng đứng đầu, rồi các cột ORDER BY với đúng chiều sắp.

5. Thang điểm

Tổng10

Lỗi hay bị trừ điểm

  • App đăng nhập bằng chủ sở hữu (hoặc postgres).
  • Đổi tên cột một bước trong khi v1 vẫn chạy.

6. Nộp bài

Các tab Q1.sql … Q4.sql (C1, C4 mở rộng, C7a, C7b). Chạy thử = kiểm mẫu; Nộp = mọi kiểm và bảng điểm thang 10. Rồi làm phần ứng dụng (đề thứ hai) trên máy bạn.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

WITH m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh') AS thang,   -- the month in VIETNAM time
         count(*) AS so_don, sum(amount) AS doanh_thu
  FROM payment
  WHERE paid_at >= timestamptz '2026-08-01 00:00+07' AND paid_at < timestamptz '2026-11-01 00:00+07'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT to_char(thang, 'YYYY-MM') AS thang, so_don::int AS so_don, doanh_thu,
       sum(doanh_thu) OVER (ORDER BY thang) AS luy_ke,
       round(100 * (doanh_thu / lag(doanh_thu) OVER (ORDER BY thang) - 1), 1) AS tang_pct
FROM m
ORDER BY thang;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

CREATE FUNCTION plan_nodes(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json; out text := '';
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON, COSTS OFF) ' || q INTO j;
  WITH RECURSIVE n(p) AS (SELECT j -> 0 -> 'Plan' UNION ALL SELECT x FROM n, json_array_elements(n.p -> 'Plans') x)
  SELECT string_agg((p ->> 'Node Type') || coalesce(' on ' || (p ->> 'Index Name'), ''), ' / ') INTO out FROM n;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_text(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_rows(q text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE j json;
BEGIN
  EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) ' || q INTO j;
  RETURN (j -> 0 -> 'Plan' ->> 'Plan Rows')::numeric::bigint;
END $f$;
CREATE FUNCTION plan_analyze(q text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $f$
DECLARE r record; out text := '';
BEGIN
  FOR r IN EXECUTE 'EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF, BUFFERS OFF) ' || q LOOP out := out || r."QUERY PLAN" || E'\n'; END LOOP;
  RETURN out;
END $f$;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

# Lab 9 — the application part (lesson 16.5 has lab9-starter.zip, lab9-start.sql and the full solution)
docker exec -it pgdemo createdb -U postgres ctlab9
docker cp lab9-start.sql pgdemo:/tmp/ && docker exec -it pgdemo psql -U postgres -d ctlab9 -f /tmp/lab9-start.sql
unzip lab9-starter.zip && cd lab9-starter && npm ci && cp .env.example .env
# C1 sql/roles.sql as postgres · C2 db pull → baseline 0_init (IDENTITY + the 11 CHECKs by hand) → migrate resolve --applied
# C3 BigInt/Decimal JSON, keyset pagination, N+1 (npm run n1) · C4 expand → v1 + v2 side by side → contract
# C5 checkout in ONE interactive transaction, sorted cart, retry on 40001/40P01 (npm run race)
# C6 payment without holding a connection during the gateway call (npm run load)
# C7 report via $queryRaw, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) before/after two CONCURRENTLY migrations
# C8 npm test (database rebuilt from the migrations) · C9 sql/kiem-tra.sql + a restore drill
npm test

Runs on YOUR machine, not in the browser. It is a Node.js application with Prisma, a real PostgreSQL server, concurrent clients and load tests; none of that runs in the browser grader. Nothing here is graded automatically: do the steps in your own PostgreSQL, compare with the expected output, then press Mark as solved.

Requirements

  • npm test prints 8 pass, 0 fail; prisma migrate diff prints "This is an empty migration."
  • A database rebuilt from your migrations has 11 CHECK constraints and refuses stock = -5.
  • Two buyers of the last unit: exactly one 201 and one 409; 400 payments with a pool of 5 all succeed.

solutionCodeJson.code:
# Lab 9 — application part (expected, PostgreSQL 17 + Prisma 5.22 + Node 22)

- C2: db pull → 8 models, warning about 11 CHECK constraints; 0_init edited (IDENTITY + CHECKs); migrate resolve --applied 0_init; status "Database schema is up to date"; diff empty
- C3: ids as strings, money as strings; keyset next=<last id>; N+1: 20 orders → 68 statements vs nested select 3 vs json_agg 1
- C4: expand deployed, v1 and v2 read each other's writes; contract while v1 still runs → P2022
- C5: race — read-modify-write sells 2 of 1 unit; atomic UPDATE … WHERE stock >= qty → one 201, one 409; deadlock retried
- C6: holding the connection during the 300 ms gateway → P2024 timeouts; short transactions → 400/400, p50 ≈ 327 ms
- C7: report 75 · 64 · 92 · 69 orders Jan–Apr 2026; EXPLAIN before 2 318 pages → after 25 pages; "My orders" no Sort
- C8: npm test → 8 pass, 0 fail
- C9: kiem-tra.sql read line by line; restore drill row counts match

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The capstone applies the whole course to an application: least-privilege roles, migrations you can replay, a checkout that is correct under concurrency, a pool sized by arithmetic, indexes justified by EXPLAIN, and operations you have rehearsed.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Đồ án áp cả khoá học vào một ứng dụng: role quyền tối thiểu, migration phát lại được, thanh toán đúng khi đồng thời, pool chỉnh cỡ bằng phép tính, chỉ mục có EXPLAIN chứng minh, và vận hành đã diễn tập.
